about: docs/structure.md 12.0r. `pictures`: the texts a Photo draws (a base64 JPEG, PNG or WebP, told by its first bytes) and the ones it does not (a face(..) takes the JPEGs only and is not changed; the picture a PhotoField gives is always a JPEG, so replay refuses a PNG or a WebP as its value); a text is head + fill repeated up to len characters (tail at the end), so no picture is kept here. Run by crates/cancho-ui/tests/photo.rs against cancho_ui_ir::photo::picture_ok and by scripts/check-photo.js against the page's __cui_photo_ok. `valid`: a view (of component C) that must check. `refusals`: a view and the rule tag that refuses it. `values`: what a handler of a PhotoField may be told, for replay (trace-value-not-a-photo).

valid.name: the least and the most of the limits
valid.view: PhotoField { label: "a" max_side: 32 max_chars: 100 on: Chosen } PhotoField { label: "b" max_side: 4096 max_chars: 48000 on: Chosen }

valid.name: a photo with every key

valid.name: a photo with a literal tone

valid.name: a decorative photo

valid.name: a photo of each row of a For

valid.name: a photo first in a cover card and a banner
